title: Act: Add focusedObjectId and setFocusedObject to gameStore
summary: Extend GameStoreState and the zustand creator with focus field and action
description: Add a focusedObjectId field defaulting to null and a setFocusedObject action to useGameStore in gameStore.ts without changing init or setState.
definition_of_done: Interface and creator updated; tsc passes

steps.action: Add the fields focusedObjectId: string | null and setFocusedObject: (id: string | null) => void to the interface after init.
steps.code:
focusedObjectId: string | null;
  setFocusedObject: (id: string | null) => void;
steps.expected: Interface declares the focus field and action.

steps.action: In the create callback add focusedObjectId: null as the default and setFocusedObject: (id) => set({ focusedObjectId: id }) after the init entry.
steps.code:
focusedObjectId: null,
  setFocusedObject: (id) => set({ focusedObjectId: id }),
steps.expected: useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId is null and setFocusedObject updates it.
